title: Representative vertex of a matching edge
statement: Let $q$ and $k$ be natural numbers, let a perfect matching be given in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part, and let $e$ be one of its edges. The chosen representative of $e$ is a vertex of the matching incident to $e$.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices per part
